dct_description_sm:
The Collar Data Excel file contains all collar-location records used in the study. It includes the following fields:
LAT - Latitude of the collar location in decimal degrees.
Long - Longitude of the collar location in decimal degrees.
Animal ID - Unique identifier assigned to each individual animal.
Sex - Sex of the individual, recorded as Male or Female.
Status - Survival status of the individual at the time of the record, where 0 = alive and 1 = dead.
Record - Date and time associated with the collar-location record.
Age - Age of the individual in years.
Dependents - Number of dependents associated with the individual. This field is recorded as NA for males.

The second attachment is a shapefile, it contains the CMA spatial units used in the study. The attribute table contains one field:
CMA - Numerical identifier assigned to each CMA unit. (Cougar Management Area = CMA)
dct_title_s: Biological and environmental correlates of cougar (Puma concolor) survival in west central Alberta (PONE-D-26-14840R1)
